kind: A screen by slope on the server's delayed test bed, two seeds, 6,000 and 24,000 updates: weight decay on synapses only, the stack's charges, offsets and gains left out of it.
why: The trainer decays every parameter of two or more dimensions (experiments/common.py), and in a stack that includes what are not synapses: every read's gain (the sharpness of its race), grain (its read resolution) and offsets by age, every cell's resting charge and the knowledge cells' offsets. At the full-size pair's 6e-4 and weight decay 0.05 the pull toward each starting value shrinks it by a factor of about e^-1.35 over 90,000 updates unless the gradient holds it, and it acts most where learning is slowest, late. A Transformer never decays its norms or attention temperatures. v15's handoff listed exempting them as untested hygiene. The stack falls behind the Transformer as data grows (pair_curves.json), and no cause found so far explains it; if the decay of its controls is one, leaving them out is a fix for late learning that costs no parameter and no pulse.

arms.synapses-only: --decay-synapses-only (b2a2117): decay acts on synapses only; the parameters named in CONTROL_PARAMETERS (on the bed: the reads' gain, grain and age, the cells' rest) keep their values but for the gradient; 5,249,060 parameters, as the base

base: bed24-lr12-s1 1.486381, bed24-lr12-s2 1.492556, rd-base-6k-s1 1.621562, rd-base-6k-s2 1.628309: the delayed bed at 1.2e-3 with decay on everything of two dimensions, the same seeds and lengths.
runs: nd-6k-s1, nd-6k-s2, nd-24k-s1, nd-24k-s2: seeds 20001 and 20002, through sched/bin/arm.sh stack with --lr 1.2e-3 (and --steps 6000) --decay-synapses-only, on the code copy of b2a2117, on GPU 0 at priority 36. Beside them on the laptop, reported and not deciding: nd-6k-s3 and nd-24k-s3 against rd-base-6k-s3 1.628284 and rd-base-24k-s3 1.482467.
measure: arm.sh's score: experiments/eval_stream.py on the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as 16 unbroken streams after 8,192 lead bytes, averaged weights; each run paired with the base of its seed and length (experiments/compare_stream_scores.py) and split by context (experiments/gap_by_piece.py, near 240, far 8,192); the controls' sizes at the end of training against the base's (how far each read's gain, grain and offsets and each cell's rest moved).
reading: The shared reading of experiments/read_lead_study.py against the base: a fix for late learning if at 24,000 updates the mean lead is at least 0.010 with both seeds ahead and it grew by at least 0.005 since 6,000; a constant gain if it leads by that much without the growth; otherwise it fails that reading. Because the option costs nothing, a smaller mark adopts it: a mean lead of at least 0.003 at 24,000 updates with both seeds ahead makes it the default of every full-size run recorded after this verdict (the full-length runs already queued keep their flags). A lead that grows by at least 0.005 from 6,000 to 24,000 updates without the 0.003 earns the pair at 96,000 updates, in a record written then.
seen_before_recording: The list of decayed parameters of the released looped stack (fsp-loop): of its controls, the age offsets (45,056), the cells' rests (13,068), the knowledge cells' offsets (11,264) and the reads' gains and grains (88 each) decay, the forgetting slopes (one dimension) do not. The tests of b2a2117 and the suite (1,423 passed). No run with the option has trained.
